about_headline: A Kolkata cab company built around the duty slip.
about_intro: JyotiCab.com provides chauffeur-driven cars from our base in Kasba, Kolkata, for companies, families and travellers who need a car they can rely on.
about_body:
We started with a simple idea: a cab bill should be easy to check. Every duty we run is measured garage-out to garage-in, written on a duty slip that your traveller fills in by hand, and charged on the hours or kilometres actually used. No hidden add-ons, and no arguments at the end of the month.

Today we look after daily office duties for companies across Kolkata, airport pickups and drops at any hour, and outstation trips to plants, project sites and holiday destinations across West Bengal and neighbouring states. Our fleet runs from the everyday Dzire to the Innova Hycross for leadership travel and guests.

Our drivers are experienced, courteous and know the city's roads, from Sector V and New Town to Howrah, Behala and the airport. Cars are cleaned before every duty and serviced on schedule. If a car develops a problem on the road, we send a replacement as quickly as traffic allows.

For companies, we work the way your accounts team does: contract rates, GST invoices after each duty or on a weekly, fortnightly or monthly cycle, and one number to call for every booking or change.

about_points.title: Billing you can check
about_points.text: Reporting and release time and kilometres are written on the duty slip in your traveller's own handwriting.

about_points.title: Charged on actual use
about_points.text: Extra hours or extra kilometres beyond the package, whichever is higher. Never both.

about_points.title: Registered and compliant
about_points.text: GST-registered and Udyam (MSME) registered, with a proper GST invoice for every duty.

about_points.title: One point of contact
about_points.text: Call, WhatsApp or email the same team for bookings, changes and billing questions, any time of day.

find_us_text: Our office and garage are on Rajdanga Main Road in Kasba, a few minutes from the EM Bypass. Every duty starts and ends here.
